basis: CAS Services is Clinical Solutions: in March 2005 the company was acquired by a consortium of Bridgepoint, Allco Finance Group and Benchmark Capital (Digital Health, 2006-04), and the register shows the three as the holders of the acquisition vehicle Clinical Solutions Holdings Limited (05337596: Balderton Capital II LP, Bridgepoint Capital (Nominees) Limited, Allco (CAS) SPV 1 Pty Ltd; annual return filed 2012-01-20); sold to Capita for GBP 20M in May 2012. An acquisition of control by the investor group, not a venture round (T3, Erik 2026-09-04; decisions.md R2); raised for Erik

note: ICUE Limited (UK 05432314, founders Marc and Lorraine Lewis, London): software for reading books on mobile phones. The register lists Benchmark Europe II, L.P. as a member from 2006-05-22 with 3,300 ordinary shares, 6,600 under Balderton Capital II by 2009; the record names no round, so the stage stays undetermined. Dissolved 2010-09-28 (register). Identified 2026-09-27 through the share register
